newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan accepts bid for 42,016 tonnes rice sale.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan accepts bid for 42,016 tonnes rice sale.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had accepted the lowest bid at $238 per tonne CIF for the sale of 42,016 tonnes of IRRI-6 variety rice.
The corporation had received 10 bids -- the lowest at $238 and the highest at $360 per tonne CIF --, when bids were opened on December 24, one dealer said.
The lowest bidder wanted to buy the entire 42,016 tonnes while others wanted small lots, a corporation official said.
The corporation accepted the lowest bid with a total worth of $10 million from a Pakistani company seeking the whole lot, the official said.
